get.summary: Signed-in user and the organizations they belong to

post.summary: Create an organization; the caller becomes its owner
post.description: Seeds the default chart of accounts in the same transaction.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

get.summary: Organizations the caller is a member of
One organization with the caller’s role

patch.summary: Update the organization’s name, tax id or small-business status start date
patch.description: Changing `sbsEffectiveFrom` changes which income counts in the declarations (they are computed on request).

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

post.description: Emails a single-use link to `<web>/invite/<token>`, valid for 7 days. The token is never returned or stored in clear.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

post.summary: What an invitation token is for
Accept an invitation as the signed-in user
post.description: The signed-in email must match the invited email.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

get.description: GEL per `quantity` units, one row per day a rate starts (`validFrom`). The rate for a date is the row with the greatest `validFrom` on or before it (SPEC §2.3).

post.summary: Queue a backfill of NBG rates for a date range (admin)
post.description: Idempotent: dates already stored are not duplicated. Emits `rates.backfilled` when done. Temporary admin check: the `x-admin-token` header (replaced by WS-05).

get.summary: Accounts of the organization (chart of accounts and bank accounts)
get.description: Active accounts, oldest first; `includeArchived=true` adds archived ones.

post.summary: Create an account (a bank account needs a currency; the IBAN is optional)

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

get.summary: Balance of every account per currency, and bank accounts in GEL
get.description: Balances are on the normal side of the account (credit for liability, equity and income). Bank accounts are also valued in GEL at the latest stored NBG rate; no NBG request is made.

patch.summary: Rename, archive or restore an account
patch.description: Archived accounts are hidden from pickers but keep their history. A bank account can only be archived at a zero balance; system accounts cannot be archived.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

post.summary: Upload a bank statement and get a preview batch
post.description: Detects the format, parses the file, matches or creates the bank account on IBAN + currency and marks rows already in the ledger (or repeated in the file) as `duplicate`. The file itself is not stored. At most 5 MB.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

get.summary: One import batch with its bank account
Parsed rows of a batch in statement order (the preview)

patch.summary: Choose the account a preview row books against, or skip it

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

post.summary: Set the account of several preview rows, or skip them, at once
post.description: Same rules as `PATCH .../rows/:rowId`, all or nothing. Duplicate rows are left as they are and listed in `ignored`.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

post.summary: Re-apply the categorisation rules to the unedited rows of a preview
post.description: Rows with an account the user chose, and duplicates, keep what they have. The others get the first matching rule, else the fixed suggestion. Returns every row.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

post.summary: Book every new row of a preview batch, one transaction per row
post.description: Each row is converted to GEL at the NBG rate of its booked date. Fails with 422 if a `new` row has no account (pick one or skip the row). Rows found in the ledger since the upload are marked `duplicate` instead of being booked. `warnings` lists booked rows whose GEL equivalent on the statement differs from ours by more than 1 tetri.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

post.summary: What a manual transaction would book, with GEL equivalents, without booking
post.description: Same body and checks as `POST /transactions`. A missing NBG rate is `503 rate_unavailable`.

post.summary: Book a manual transaction from one of the canonical events
post.description: Income receipt, expense, owner draw or contribution, transfer, currency exchange or tax payment; `postings` (raw, signed, balanced per currency) is for the owner only. Every posting is converted to GEL at the NBG rate of `occurredOn`; a missing rate is `503 rate_unavailable`. Source `manual`.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

get.summary: Transactions with postings, GEL equivalents and NBG rates, newest first
One transaction with its postings and rates

post.summary: Post the reversing transaction (every posting negated)
post.description: Posted transactions never change; a reversal is the only correction. Same accounts, rates and payment method, so the SBS income it posted comes back out. Send `{}` for the defaults.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

get.summary: Categorisation rules in the order they are tried

post.summary: Create a categorisation rule (tried after the existing ones)
post.description: New uploads apply it straight away; open previews pick it up with `POST /imports/:batchId/apply-rules`.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

patch.description: Only the fields sent change; null clears a condition.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

delete.description: Rows it already suggested keep their account. Returns the deleted rule.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

post.summary: Set the order the rules are tried in
post.description: Send every rule id of the organization, first tried first.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

get.summary: Monthly SBS declaration figures for a year, with filing status and drift
get.description: Per month: line 15 (`ytdGelMinor`), lines 18–21 (`byPaymentMethod`), rate, tax and deadline, computed from posted transactions on every request, plus `status` against the latest filing (drift lists the lines that moved). Without `year`: the latest year with posted transactions, else the current year.

get.summary: One monthly return laid out like rs.ge, with its transactions and filings

post.summary: Record that the return was filed on rs.ge: stores an immutable snapshot
post.description: Snapshots the live figures, rules version and contributing transactions of the month. Nothing is sent to rs.ge. If the month is already filed, this files a correction: send the latest filing id as `supersedesId` (409 otherwise). Snapshots are never changed or deleted. 409 also when the month is not over yet or needs no return.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key; replays return the stored response for 24 h.

get.summary: Year-to-date SBS income, income by month, counterparty and currency, deadlines
get.description: Without `year`: the latest year with posted transactions, else the current year in Tbilisi. Counterparty and currency figures cover SBS income from the status start.
